name: Minecraft Theme
author: jaquesbody
description: Switchable Minecraft theme for Omarchy with six Quickshell plugins: HUD, inventory, Steve companion, death menu, toasts, splash, sounds, screensaver and a grass-block bar cube. Installs via scripts/install.sh (see README) and reverts cleanly with scripts/uninstall.sh.

barWidget.description: Grass-block button that toggles the Minecraft theme.
